⚠️ TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Channel-Port aux Basques RCMP is reporting that icy road conditions, high winds and limited visibility due to snow are impacting travel conditions through the Wreckhouse.

While roads remain passable, motorists should expect delays and are asked to drive with extreme caution and patience. Slow down and obey all instructions from first responders. A reminder that the Move Over Law requires that you slow down for emergency vehicles.

Please consider delaying all non-essential travel. If you must travel, please exercise caution and patience and drive according to road and weather conditions.

data.text:
Airplanes line the tarmac and taxiways at Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Parañaque City on Monday, April 6, reflecting steady air traffic at the country’s primary gateway.

The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) is pushing for the adoption of Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) to cut aviation carbon emissions by up to 65 to 80 percent through safe blending with conventional jet fuel. To support this transition, CAAP and industry stakeholders convened the 2026 Sustainable Aviation Fuel Policy Development Workshop at the National Aviation Academy of the Philippines, focusing on feedstock supply, production technology, capacity-building, regulatory support, airline participation, and investment opportunities.

The agency said the Philippines is well-positioned for SAF adoption due to its strong agricultural base, as it continues to advance cleaner aviation and strengthen the country’s role in sustainable air transport.

📸: Mark Balmores/MB
